native-rpm.origin: Release native RPM including statically linked Go modules and dynamically linked library references
native-rpm.integrity: Exact RPM sha256, rpm -qpl/-qpR, ELF NEEDED/static readelf and go version -m evidence
native-rpm.notices: RPM %license LICENSE and third-party-notices; inspect exact payload
native-rpm.source_fulfilment: Retain release Go/toolchain/module provenance and applicable full notices; assess native linkage obligations from actual RPM

responsibility.update: S2 prepares RPM; customer schedules update
responsibility.support: S2 native agent software; customer host services

native-rpm.origin: Customer-approved OS/vendor repositories: libvirt-daemon >=11.10.0, libvirt-daemon-driver-qemu >=11.10.0, python3-libvirt >=11.10.0, qemu-img >=10.1.0, acl, polkit, systemd, python3, util-linux, shadow-utils
native-rpm.integrity: RPM dependency transaction plus actual host inventory/linkage acceptance
native-rpm.notices: Customer/vendor notices for genuinely external host packages
native-rpm.source_fulfilment: Customer/vendor source route; linked combination rights remain subject to actual RPM inspection

responsibility.install: Customer installs prerequisites; RPM does not vendor these packages
responsibility.support: Customer host/libvirt/QEMU operations; S2 native agent integration

qualification_required: Exact release image/OCI-layer OS package and native wheel inventory
Go build/module and browser embedded-component inventory
Exact native RPM contents, dependencies and ELF linkage
Complete applicable notices and release-specific source/patch/build material or reviewed valid fulfilment route
Record evidence digests and reviewer acceptance separately; pending contract is not legal qualification

broader_app_only_assessment.tradeoff: Compare customer preparation, pinning, compatibility, native linkage/replacement and support costs against maintaining compliant full images before adding a delivery profile. Install-time downloads or S2 caches do not erase upstream obligations.

historical_scope: Earlier deliveries require a bounded exact-artifact inventory; this policy makes no claim of historical noncompliance.

customer_postgresql.acquisition_owner: Customer independently obtains and verifies from upstream/vendor or its own mirror. No PostgreSQL image transferred in this profile. An S2 mirror/cache/archive would supply copies and requires reassessment.
customer_postgresql.qualification: pending exact PostgreSQL version, TLS/authentication, migration, backup/restore and recovery evidence
